verdict.rationale: Vercel documents a BotID product explicitly described as 'an invisible CAPTCHA that protects against sophisticated bots without challenges' and 'protect sensitive routes from sophisticated bots with an invisible check instead of a CAPTCHA,' directly matching the story's request for invisible challenge-based bot protection, alongside complementary firewall rules for blocking scrapers/attacks. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of BotID's real-world efficacy and no community corroboration of this specific feature (only unrelated security-incident commentary exists).
